scope: Strict-prequential research-only MC1-equivalent ablation above the frozen short P0→O250/H6→C3→K0 stack. No canonical/live change.

contract.upstream: frozen P0 → O250/H6 → C3 normalized-regret → K0 outer-OOF predictions
contract.mapper: fixed HistGradientBoostingRegressor depth 2; no HPO; H12 policy net clipped to ±500 bps only for mapper fitting
contract.outer_fit: only earlier OOF rows with label_available_at < held month start
contract.correctness: prior-resolved only, strict before decision, equal-day 21d residual/hit-rate state with 10% trim
contract.agreement: target-free O/C/K0 dispersion across the five separately strict-OOF C-target arms
contract.demotion_admission: native K0 p80 admission AND MC mapped expected policy net >= +50 bps; MC cannot manufacture an admission

direct_mc1_agreement.decision: does not advance: higher total contribution is caused by broad extra admissions while EV/trade, 2026 EV, and CVaR worsen

native_k0_plus_mc1_agreement_demotion.decision: promising challenger only: higher EV/trade and materially improved worst month with a 1.2% total-EV reduction. It needs a predeclared later-period confirmation before any architecture decision.

caveat: The active roadmap keeps P0→O→C→K0 as the frozen architecture. The MC1-equivalent arms, including the conservative demoter, are noncanonical research evidence. 2025–2026 were used for target selection and this challenger comparison, so they are not untouched promotion evidence.
